ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلٰى عَبْدِهٖ لِیَكُوْنَ لِلْعٰلَمِیْنَ نَذِیْرَاۙ
ayahs.translation: Highly blessed is He, Who has sent down Al-Furqan, to His servant so that it may be a warner to all mankind:

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ لَمْ یَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِیْكٌ فِی الْمُلْكِ وَ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقْدِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: He to Whom belongs the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth: Who has begotten no son: Who has no partner in His Sovereignty: Who created each and every thing and then ordained its destiny.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً لَّا یَخْلُقُوْنَ شَیْئًا وَّ هُمْ یُخْلَقُوْنَ وَ لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ لِاَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا نَفْعًا وَّ لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ مَوْتًا وَّ لَا حَیٰوةً وَّ لَا نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Yet the people have set up, besides Him, deities, who do not create anything but are themselves created: who can neither harm nor help even themselves: who have no power over life or death, nor can they raise up the dead.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اِفْكُ اِ۟فْتَرٰىهُ وَ اَعَانَهٗ عَلَیْهِ قَوْمٌ اٰخَرُوْنَ١ۛۚ فَقَدْ جَآءُوْ ظُلْمًا وَّ زُوْرًاۚۛ
ayahs.translation: Those who have rejected the Message of the Prophet, say, "This (Al-Furgan) is a forgery which this man himself has devised, and some others have helped him at it. " What a cruel injustice and an impudent lie!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِیَ تُمْلٰى عَلَیْهِ بُكْرَةً وَّ اَصِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: They say, "These things are the writings of the ancients which he has got copied down for himself, and then these are recited to him in the morning and evening.''

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِیْ یَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِیْمًا
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad, say to them, "This has been sent down by Him, Who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth." The fact is that He is very Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوْلِ یَاْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَ یَمْشِیْ فِی الْاَسْوَاقِ١ؕ لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْهِ مَلَكٌ فَیَكُوْنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِیْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: They say, "What sort of a Messenger is he that he eats food and moves about in the streets? Why has not an angel been sent down to accompany him and threaten (the disbelievers)?

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ یُلْقٰۤى اِلَیْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ تَكُوْنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ یَّاْكُلُ مِنْهَا١ؕ وَ قَالَ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِنْ تَتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Or why has not at least a treasure been sent down for him or a garden given to him for (easy) sustenance?" And the wicked people say, "You are following a man bewitched."

ayahs.arabicText: اُنْظُرْ كَیْفَ ضَرَبُوْا لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْا فَلَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Just see what strange arguments they bring forward with regard to you! They have gone so far astray that they cannot charge any thing against you.

ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَیْرًا مِّنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ۙ وَ یَجْعَلْ لَّكَ قُصُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Highly blessed is He, Who, if He wills, could give you much more and better things than what they propose for you: (Not one but) many gardens, beneath which rivers flow; and big castles:

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالسَّاعَةِ١۫ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِیْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: The fact of the matter is that these people have denied "the Hour", --And for the one who denies the coming of the Hour, We have prepared a blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذَا رَاَتْهُمْ مِّنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ سَمِعُوْا لَهَا تَغَیُّظًا وَّ زَفِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: When it will see them from afar, they will hear the sounds of its raging and roaring.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَاۤ اُلْقُوْا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَیِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِیْنَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And when they are chained together and flung into a narrow space therein, they will begin to call for death.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا تَدْعُوا الْیَوْمَ ثُبُوْرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّ ادْعُوْا ثُبُوْرًا كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: (Then it will be said to them:) "Do not call for one death today, but call for many deaths."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَیْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِیْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ١ؕ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَّ مَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Ask them "Is this (Fire) better or the everlasting Garden which has been promised to the God-fearing righteous people?" which will be the recompense of their good deeds and the final destination of their journey

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِیْهَا مَا یَشَآءُوْنَ خٰلِدِیْنَ١ؕ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْئُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: wherein they will get everything they desire and wherein they will dwell for ever. This is a promise which your Lord has taken upon Himself to fulfil.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یَحْشُرُهُمْ وَ مَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَیَقُوْلُ ءَاَنْتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِیْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: And on that Day (your Lord will gather these people together as well as their deities, whom they worship besides AIlah. Then He will ask them, "Did you mislead these servants of Mine, or did they themselves go astray?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ یَنْۢبَغِیْ لَنَاۤ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُوْنِكَ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ وَ لٰكِنْ مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَ اٰبَآءَهُمْ حَتّٰى نَسُوا الذِّكْرَ١ۚ وَ كَانُوْا قَوْمًۢا بُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: They will answer, "Glory be to Thee! We dared not take anyguardian besides Thee: (they were misled because) Thou didst give them and their forefathers all the good things of life till they forgot the Admonition, and incurred the punishment. "

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْكُمْ بِمَا تَقُوْلُوْنَ١ۙ فَمَا تَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ صَرْفًا وَّ لَا نَصْرًا١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّظْلِمْ مِّنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Thus will your gods deny alI that you are professing today. Then you shall neither be able to repel your punishment nor shall get any help from anywhere; and whoso is guilty. of iniquity'' among you, We shall make him taste a severe torment.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ اِلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمْ لَیَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَ یَمْشُوْنَ فِی الْاَسْوَاقِ١ؕ وَ جَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً١ؕ اَتَصْبِرُوْنَ١ۚ وَ كَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِیْرًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad,, all the Messengers whom We sent before you also ate food and moved about in the streets. In fact, We have made you all a means of test for one another. Will you show patience? for your Lord sees everything.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَرْجُوْنَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ عَلَیْنَا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوْ نَرٰى رَبَّنَا١ؕ لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ عَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Those people, who have no fear of coming before Us, say, "Why should not the angels be sent down to us? Or else we should see our Lord. " Great arrogance have they assumed in regard to themselves, and have transgressed all limits in their rebellion.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَرَوْنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰى یَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِیْنَ وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: The Day, when they will see the angels, will not be a day of rejoicing for the criminals; they will cry out, "May Allah save us!"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَدِمْنَاۤ اِلٰى مَا عَمِلُوْا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنْثُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Then We shall turn to what they had done and render it vain like scattered dust.

ayahs.arabicText: اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ یَوْمَئِذٍ خَیْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَّ اَحْسَنُ مَقِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: (On the contrary) only those who have deserved the Garden, will have a good abode on that Day and a cool place for midday rest.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَ نُزِّلَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ تَنْزِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: On that Day, a cloud will appear rending the sky and the angels will be senthi down rank after rank.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْمُلْكُ یَوْمَئِذِ اِ۟لْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ١ؕ وَ كَانَ یَوْمًا عَلَى الْكٰفِرِیْنَ عَسِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: The real Kingdom on that Day will belong only to the Merciful, and it will be a very hard Day for the disbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰى یَدَیْهِ یَقُوْلُ یٰلَیْتَنِی اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوْلِ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: The unjust man will bite at his hand and say, "Would that I had stood by the Messenger!

ayahs.arabicText: یٰوَیْلَتٰى لَیْتَنِیْ لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: O, woe to me! Would that I had not chosen so and so for a friend!

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ اَضَلَّنِیْ عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ جَآءَنِیْ١ؕ وَ كَانَ الشَّیْطٰنُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: For it was he, who had deluded me to reject the Admonition which had come to me. Satan has proved very treacherous to man. "

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الرَّسُوْلُ یٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِی اتَّخَذُوْا هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And the Messenger will say, "O my Lord, my people had made this Qur'an the object of their ridicule."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِیٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ١ؕ وَ كَفٰى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِیًا وَّ نَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad, in this very way We have made the criminals the enemies of every Prophet, but your Lord suffices for you as your Guide and Helper.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ لَا نُزِّلَ عَلَیْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَّاحِدَةً١ۛۚ كَذٰلِكَ١ۛۚ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ وَ رَتَّلْنٰهُ تَرْتِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: The disbelievers say, "Why has not the entire Qur'an been sent down to this man all at nce?" -Well, this has been done to impress it deeply on your mind, and (for the same object) We have sent it down piecemeal by degrees.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَاْتُوْنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَحْسَنَ تَفْسِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And (there is another wisdom in this: whenever they brought to you an odd thing (or a strange question), We sent its right answer to you in time and explained it all in the best manner,

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ یُحْشَرُوْنَ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْ اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: those who are going to be driven to Hell upon their faces, have taken an utterly wrong stand and their way is most erroneous!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَ جَعَلْنَا مَعَهٗۤ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ وَزِیْرًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron as his counsellor:

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَاۤ اِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِیْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا١ؕ فَدَمَّرْنٰهُمْ تَدْمِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: then We said to them, "Go to the people who have treated Our Revelations as false. " So We annihilated those people utterly.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ اَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً١ؕ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلظّٰلِمِیْنَ عَذَابًا اَلِیْمًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The same was the case with the people of Noah when they charged the Messenger with imposture: We drowned them and made them a sign of warning for entire mankind, and We have prepared a painful chastisement for the unjust.

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ عَادًا وَّ ثَمُوْدَاۡ وَ اَصْحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَ قُرُوْنًۢا بَیْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Likewise were destroyed the `Ad and the Thamud and the people of the Rass, and many a generation in between.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْاَمْثَالَ١٘ وَ كُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: We admonished each one of them by citing the examples (of those who were destroyed before them) and ultimately annihilated all of them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْیَةِ الَّتِیْۤ اُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ١ؕ اَفَلَمْ یَكُوْنُوْا یَرَوْنَهَا١ۚ بَلْ كَانُوْا لَا یَرْجُوْنَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Surely, these people have passed by that habitation on which was rained an evil rain: have they not seen its ruins? But they do not expect another life in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا رَاَوْكَ اِنْ یَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا١ؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِیْ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: When these people see you, they scoff at you, (saying), "Is this the man whom Allah has sent as His Messenger?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كَادَ لَیُضِلُّنَا عَنْ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَیْهَا١ؕ وَ سَوْفَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ حِیْنَ یَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: He had almost led us astray from our gods, had we not remained firm in our faith with regard to them. " The time is not far when they will see the torment and realize who had strayed far from the truth.

ayahs.arabicText: اَرَءَیْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُ١ؕ اَفَاَنْتَ تَكُوْنُ عَلَیْهِ وَكِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you ever considered the case of the person who has made his lust his god? Can you take the responsibility of guiding such a one aright?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَحْسَبُ اَنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ یَسْمَعُوْنَ اَوْ یَعْقِلُوْنَ١ؕ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا كَالْاَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are only like the cattle; nay, even worse than the cattle.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ كَیْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ١ۚ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًا١ۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَیْهِ دَلِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord lengthens out the shadow? Had He willed, He would have made it constant, but We have made the sun its pilot;

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنٰهُ اِلَیْنَا قَبْضًا یَّسِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: then (as the sun climbs up), We roll it up little by little towards Ourselves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّیْلَ لِبَاسًا وَّ النَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَّ جَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is Allah Who has ordained the night as a garment for you, and the sleep as a repose of death, and the day as the time of return to life.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَرْسَلَ الرِّیٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَیْنَ یَدَیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ۚ وَ اَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And it is He, Who drives the winds to be the harbingers of His mercy: then He sends down pure water from the sky

ayahs.arabicText: لِّنُحْیَِۧ بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّیْتًا وَّ نُسْقِیَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَاۤ اَنْعَامًا وَّ اَنَاسِیَّ كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: so that He may revive the dead land, and quench the thirst of many of His creatures from among beasts and men.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنٰهُ بَیْنَهُمْ لِیَذَّكَّرُوْا١ۖ٘ فَاَبٰۤى اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: We present the same phenomenon over and over again before them so that they may learn a lesson from it; but most people decline to adopt any other attitude than of disbelief and ingratitude.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِیْ كُلِّ قَرْیَةٍ نَّذِیْرًا٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: Had We willed, We would have raised up a separate Warner in each habitation.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ وَ جَاهِدْهُمْ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: So, O Prophet, do not yield to the disbelievers, but wage a Jihad against them with this Qur'an.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَیْنِ هٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّ هٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌ١ۚ وَ جَعَلَ بَیْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَّ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He, Who has let loose the two seas, one palatable and sweet, the other bitter and saltish, and there is a partition between them, which is an insurmountable barrier.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّ صِهْرًا١ؕ وَ كَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He, Who created man from water: then from him He caused two kinds of kindred, by blood and by marriage: your Lord is AI I-Powerful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا یَنْفَعُهُمْ وَ لَا یَضُرُّهُمْ١ؕ وَ كَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلٰى رَبِّهٖ ظَهِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Yet they worship, instead of Allah, those who can neither benefit them nor harm them: more than this, the disbeliever has become a helper of every rebel against his Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّ نَذِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad, We have sent you only to proclaim good tidings and to give warning.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ اَنْ یَّتَّخِذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Tell them, "I do not ask of you any recompense for this work: I only ask of the one, who will, to adopt the way of his Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَیِّ الَّذِیْ لَا یَمُوْتُ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهٖ١ؕ وَ كَفٰى بِهٖ بِذُنُوْبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِیْرَا٤ۚۛۙ
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad trust in that Allah Who is Ever-Living and will never die' Glorify Him with His praise, for He alone is sufficient to be aware of the sins of His servants.

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ١ۛۚ اَلرَّحْمٰنُ فَسْئَلْ بِهٖ خَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: In six days He created the earth and the heavens and all that is between them; then He established Himself on the "Throne" (of the Kingdom of the uriverse). (He is) the Merciful: as to His Glory, ask the one who knows.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا قِیْلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْا لِلرَّحْمٰنِ قَالُوْا وَ مَا الرَّحْمٰنُ١ۗ اَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَاْمُرُنَا وَ زَادَهُمْ نُفُوْرًا۠۩ ۞ ۧ
ayahs.translation: When it is said to them. "Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful," they retort, "What is the Merciful? Would you have us prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you will?" And this invitation only helps to increase their hatred all the more.

ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ فِی السَّمَآءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّ جَعَلَ فِیْهَا سِرٰجًا وَّ قَمَرًا مُّنِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Highly blessed is He, Who has made fortified spheres in the heavens and has set in it a "lamp" and a shining moon.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ یَّذَّكَّرَ اَوْ اَرَادَ شُكُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: He it is Who caused the night and the day to succeed each other so that everyone who desires may learn a lesson or become grateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمٰنِ الَّذِیْنَ یَمْشُوْنَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَّ اِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجٰهِلُوْنَ قَالُوْا سَلٰمًا
ayahs.translation: The (true) servants of the Merciful are those who walk humbly on the earth who, when the ignorant people behave insolently towards them, say, "Peace to you"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَبِیْتُوْنَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَّ قِیَامًا
ayahs.translation: who pass their nights in prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord:

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ١ۖۗ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: who pray, "Our Lord, save us from the torment of Hell, for its torment is killing:

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: it is an evil abode and an evil resting place":

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اِذَاۤ اَنْفَقُوْا لَمْ یُسْرِفُوْا وَ لَمْ یَقْتُرُوْا وَ كَانَ بَیْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
ayahs.translation: who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor miserly but keep the golden mean between the two (extremes):

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَ لَا یَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِیْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَ لَا یَزْنُوْنَ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ یَلْقَ اَثَامًاۙ
ayahs.translation: who do not invoke any god but Allah nor kill a soul, which Allah has forbidden, unjustly, nor commit adultery. -He who does this shall be punished for his sin,

ayahs.arabicText: یُّضٰعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ وَ یَخْلُدْ فِیْهٖ مُهَانًاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: and his torment shall be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and he shall abide in a state of ignominy,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ یُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَیِّاٰتِهِمْ حَسَنٰتٍ١ؕ وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِیْمًا
ayahs.translation: except the one who may have repented (after those sins) and have believed and done righteous works, for then Allah will change his evil deeds into good deeds, and He is very Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ تَابَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاِنَّهٗ یَتُوْبُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا
ayahs.translation: In fact, the one who repents and does righteous deeds, returns to Allah as one ightly should. -

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَشْهَدُوْنَ الزُّوْرَ١ۙ وَ اِذَا مَرُّوْا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْا كِرَامًا
ayahs.translation: (And the servants of the Merciful are those:) who do not bear witness to falsehood and who; if they have ever to pass by what is vain, pass by like dignified people:

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ یَخِرُّوْا عَلَیْهَا صُمًّا وَّ عُمْیَانًا
ayahs.translation: who do not behave like the blind and the deaf, when the Revelations of their Lord are recited to them for admonition;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْیُنٍ وَّ اجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ اِمَامًا
ayahs.translation: who pray, "Our Lord, bless us with wives and children, who may be the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the righteous. " -

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ یُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا وَ یُلَقَّوْنَ فِیْهَا تَحِیَّةً وَّ سَلٰمًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Such are the people who will be rewarded with high palaces for their fortitude,, wherein they will be welcomed with due respect, honour and salutations

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ؕ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: and wherein they will live for ever: what an excellent abode and what an excellent resting place!

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَا یَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّیْ لَوْ لَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ١ۚ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ یَكُوْنُ لِزَامًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: O Muhammad, tell the people, "MyLord does not care at all if you do not invoke Him. Now that you have denied (His Revelation), you will soon be awarded such a punishment which you will never be able to avoid."
